name: SOAR Playbook Builder
description: Guided playbook authoring for Splunk SOAR: template and ES-oriented scaffolds, block-flow preview, Python validation, Visual Playbook Editor import and sync, and optional natural-language drafting via an external MCP agent bridge.

mcp_bridge_url.description: Optional MCP agent bridge base URL for AI Mode B (e.g. https://bridge.internal:8003/agent). Leave empty for templates-only Mode A.

mcp_bridge_allow_insecure_http.description: Lab-only override that permits a plain HTTP MCP bridge. Keep disabled for production.

ai_instructions.description: SOC context shown in the playbook builder sidecar header
ai_instructions.default: Describe playbooks in plain language — preview, validate, and import into SOAR

soar_rest_token.description: Optional SOAR REST API token (ph-auth-token) for sidecar import when browser session loopback fails. Create under Administration → Users → Authentication for REST API.

soar_loopback_allow_insecure_tls.description: Lab-only override that disables certificate verification for SOAR REST loopback. Keep disabled; prefer a trusted certificate or CA bundle.

soar_loopback_ca_bundle.description: Optional absolute path to a PEM CA bundle trusted for HTTPS SOAR REST loopback.

asset_defaults.description: JSON map of scaffold asset keys to configured SOAR asset names, e.g. {"servicenow": "snow_lab", "soar": "local"}. Used at import to avoid Missing Configurations in the Visual Editor.

custom_templates_json.description: Legacy Python organization templates. Disabled by default because executable source bypasses the IR/preflight trust boundary. Prefer custom_ir_templates_json.

custom_ir_templates_json.description: Strict organization templates as Playbook IR 1.0 JSON (id must start with org-). Review-only until trusted import is live-qualified. See bundled CUSTOMIZATION.md.

allow_legacy_python_templates.description: Lab-only compatibility override that loads custom_templates_json Python. Keep disabled; legacy Python templates are outside the trusted compiler path.

playbook_defaults_json.description: JSON defaults for readiness auto-fix: {"constants": {"SLACK_CHANNEL": "#soc-alerts"}, "assets": {"slack": "slack_lab"}}. Constants replace placeholders in generated Python; assets merge with asset_defaults.

es_web_url.description: Splunk ES web URL (e.g. https://es.example.com:8000) — enables Back to Mission Control link in the sidecar when event_id is in the URL.

sample_cases_json.description: Optional JSON array of demo/sample cases for the sidecar case picker (merged with built-in samples). See sample_data/sample_cases.json.

operating_mode.description: Air-gap operating mode: air_gapped (no egress actions), restricted (warn on unknown egress), connected (default).

default_ui_mode.description: Default sidecar persona when URL has no mode=: studio, assistant, coach, or tutor. URL mode= always overrides.

actions.description: Verify MCP agent bridge is reachable from SOAR
Return the REST handler URL for the playbook builder sidecar

playbook_id.description: Optional playbook ID to pass to the sidecar

container_id.description: SOAR case (container) ID — links the sidecar so Run on this case works

event_id.description: Optional ES event ID for investigation context

rule_name.description: Optional ES rule/notable name for template suggestions

mode.description: Sidecar persona: studio, assistant, coach, tutor (optional — overrides default_ui_mode on asset)

tab.description: Coach tab when mode=coach: respond, explain, or build

actions.description: Harvest installed apps, actions, assets, and vocabularies from local SOAR REST and persist the capability index
Return capability index version, age, app/action counts, and harvest health
Export non-secret Playbook Builder asset configuration as JSON for migration (secrets are always excluded)
Import previously exported asset configuration JSON onto this asset

config_json.description: Export bundle or configuration object JSON

confirm.description: Set true to apply after preview

actions.description: Verify capability index, templates, demo data, and optional MCP bridge health
